claims.title: Candidate three-body thermal-memory variants;energy/connectivity and loading limits

quoted_fields.interface: Use the candidate three-body qubit Hamiltonian,its parent3D proposal,declared noise/temperature/interaction regime and required thermal input. These model definitions,parameters,lifetime/error/size bounds and numerical resource scales are UNSUPPLIED in the two brief reports. The parent proposal is not identified here with N1645 or any other existing record;no inherited robustness or model identity is asserted. The new report identifies a DIFFERENT variant;do not transfer a model identity,noise theorem,correction closure or full proof between the two variants. No absolute energy scale,temperature,coupling,auxiliary graph degree,loading cost or lifetime/error bound is supplied.
quoted_fields.failure: Candidate status and corrections being incorporated remain. Reviews of parts do not establish the full proof. The source noise model is specified by the producer but not supplied here;no general hardware-error tolerance is inferred. Conservative sufficient temperature is not a physical impossibility threshold. The earlier N1638 graph-local high-body autonomous noisy-witness/reset construction retains its native few-body,3D,reset and noisy-input/output obligations;these reports do not close them. No lifetime exponent,Hamiltonian,preparation operation,proof unit or benchmark is invented from these brief reports. The new energy-scale check is scoped to the different variant and does not establish a full practical memory or close corrections/full-proof obligations. First-variant conservative sufficient temperature remains distinct from a necessary physical limit. No guarantee is imported into N1638/N1645.
